title: daphne nutans
intro: Daphne nutans, commonly known as the fragrant or mountain laurel, is a perennial shrub plant that belongs to the Thymelaeaceae family. It has been traditionally used in medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Daphne nutans include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and act as a diuretic. Its bioactive constituents include daphnetin, a lignan, and other phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
